security_summary: Requested: SOC2 Type II evidence, full list of sub-processors, DPA with standard liability and data handling clauses.
We shared: SOC2 summary doc (high-level controls), redacted auditor letter (if allowed), and sub-processor list (AWS, GCP, Sentry, Datadog).
They want confirmation: no human review of PII in logs; we described automated monitoring and access controls.
Retention: proposed default 30-day request/response retention for hosted trial; customer asked about 7/90/365 options.
DPA request: merchantmosaic legal will propose two changes around data deletion SLAs and subprocessors' notice period.

Order-triage: classify incoming emails/chats into returns/refund/escalation buckets and attach suggested next actions for agents.
